facts.text: As Haven Gotham, graduated from SUNY Potsdam's Crane School of Music in 2021 with a Bachelor of Music in music education (voice concentration) and received the 2021 Chancellor's Award for Student Excellence
As Haven Gotham, received the first Dr. Rebecca Reames Memorial Scholarship at SUNY Potsdam's Crane School of Music, 2021
Practices clinically at North Coast Physical Therapy, with specialty certification in pediatric physical therapy
Co-authored "Roles of Post-Translational Modifications of Transcription Factors Involved in Breast Cancer Hypoxia" in Molecules, Feb 2025
Co-authored the chapter "Mass Spectrometry-Based Identification of Post-Translational Modifications (PTMs) of Proteins" in Advancements of Mass Spectrometry in Biomedical Research, 2026
Co-authored the chapter "Mass Spectrometry- and Structural Biology-Based Investigation of Proteins" in Advancements of Mass Spectrometry in Biomedical Research, 2026
Named by his father Eric as a business partner in From the Heart Cabinetry, Feb 2020
Works as Growth and Relationships Manager at Stewardship in Liverpool, England, under her married name Annika Greco Thompson

Received the Hultberg Scholarship, Pamela Michne Fox '59 Music Scholarship, Barrington Merit Scholarship, Curtis B. Bailey & Irma B. Bailey Memorial Scholarship, Ken Cottrell Outstanding Human Service Award, SUNY Potsdam Travel Award, Crane Youth Music Schaberg Scholarship, SUNY Potsdam Freshman Scholars Award, and Edwin and Eleanor Strand Music Loan Fund at SUNY Potsdam
Scored a goal in Clarkson's 6-1 win over Providence, Oct 24, 2026
